CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 23, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
CITY COUNCIL
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Rabbi Len Muroff, Temple Beth Ohr
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Friends of the La Mirada Theatre
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD FOR DUNKEL
BROS. – It is recommended the City Council present Dunkel Bros. with a Community Spotlight Award.
5.1 Dunkel Bros Recognition
5.2
RECOGNITION OF SAINT PAUL OF THE CROSS SCHOOL'S FAITH AND CHEER PROGRAM – It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the Saint Paul of the Cross School's Faith and Cheer program and present them with a Certificate of Recognition.
5.2 Saint Paul of the Cross - Faith and Cheer
5.3
RECOGNITION OF A FORMER ADVISORY BODY MEMBER – It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to David Morfin for his years of dedicated service to the community.
5.3 Former Advisory Member - Morfin
6.
APPOINTMENTS
6.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Carmen Hernandez to the Planning Commission for a term ending in June 2030.
6.2
APPOINTMENTS TO ADVISORY BODIES – It is recommended the City Council reappoint Erin Berry and Rebecca Cline to the Community Services Commission for terms expiring in June 2030; reappoint Lee Olsen to the Planning Commission for a term expiring in June 2030; and reappoint Ellen Peters and Moses Covarrubias to the Public Safety Commission for terms expiring in June 2030.
7.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council.)
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of June 9, 2026 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of June 9, 2026.
8.1 Study Session Minutes
8.1 City Council Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 23, 2026 in the total amount of $2,109,440.48.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
ANNUAL REPORT OF THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Annual Report of the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation.
8.3 Annual Report - Theatre Foundation
8.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING MAY 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending May 2026.
8.4 Investment Report - May 2026
8.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MARCH 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending March 2026.
8.5 Treasurer Report - March 2026
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-06, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 7 – APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER NO. 1 – It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 1 for Capital Improvement Project No. 2025-06, Neighborhood Slurry Seal Area 7, in the amount of $229,424.30.
8.6 CIP No. 2025-06 Neighborhood Slurry Seal
8.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-04, TELEGRAPH ROAD AT WICKER DRIVE/HUTCHINS DRIVE NEW TRAFFIC SIGNAL - FINDING THAT PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT OF 1970, THE PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT UNDER SECTION 15301 CLASS 1 (C), APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, AND APPROVAL OF COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES – It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2020-04, Telegraph Road at Wicker Drive/Hutchins Drive New Traffic Signal; approve the Cooperative Agreement with the County of Los Angeles and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.7 CIP No. 2020-04 Telegraph Road at Wicker Drive
8.8
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH AMERINAT – It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with AmeriNat for escrow and loan services and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.8 Professional Svcs. Agreement with Amerinat
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-21 APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION PROGRAM - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-21 approving the City’s participation in the Los Angeles Urban County Permanent Local Housing Allocation Program and authorizing the City Manager to execute the documents required for participation in the program.
9.1 Resolution No. 26-21 Local Housing Allocation Program
10.
CITY COUNCIL REPORTS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
11.
CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS
12.
CITY MANAGER ANNOUNCEMENTS
13.
CLOSED SESSION
13.1
CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957 – PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION: CITY ATTORNEY
14.
ADJOURNMENT
I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
